title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Windows Desktop Build 285 (Smooth Navigation & Performance)
highlights: Smooth Mobile Swiping: Fixed tab swipe freeze and white screen flashing between Home, Invoices, Customers, and Products by stabilizing the mobile tab shell in AnimatedSwitcher.
Instant 1-Tap New Bill: Fixed New Bill button on Dashboard so a single tap opens the invoice billing screen immediately without screen blinking or requiring a second tap.
Gesture & PageView Stability: Eliminated conflicting PostFrameCallback jumpToPage calls and redundant animateToPage triggers for uninterrupted 120fps gesture navigation.
fixes: Stabilized AnimatedSwitcher subtree key for mobile shell tabs to keep PageView alive across tab navigation.
Resolved 1st-tap New Bill blink by removing duplicate animation triggers in HomeScreen.
Eliminated post-frame jumpToPage calls during build to ensure seamless touch swiping.
